controls.description: Local pinned Node image exists with exact digest without pulling from remote
Main services fg-local-postgres-1 and fg-local-redis-1 are running and healthy prior to execution
Existing Docker network fg-local_default exists and contains PostgreSQL container
Cycle A container created with strict isolation parameters
controls.assertion: createdA.Config.User === 'node' && createdA.HostConfig.ReadonlyRootfs === true && createdA.HostConfig.NetworkMode === 'none' && createdA.Config.Labels['fg-owner'] === ownerTagA

controls.description: Cycle A execution finishes cleanly within timeout
Cycle A output file result-raw.json conforms to schema
controls.assertion: raw.mode === 'without-preload' && raw.preloadInstalled === false && raw.allOk === true && raw.errorCode === null && raw.stages.length === 6 && raw.stages.every(s => s.ok === true)

controls.description: Cycle B container created with strict isolation parameters
controls.assertion: createdB.Config.User === 'node' && createdB.HostConfig.ReadonlyRootfs === true && createdB.HostConfig.NetworkMode === 'none' && createdB.Config.Labels['fg-owner'] === ownerTagB

controls.description: Cycle B execution finishes cleanly within timeout
Cycle B output file result-preload.json conforms to schema
controls.assertion: preload.mode === 'with-preload' && preload.preloadInstalled === true && preload.allOk === true && preload.errorCode === null && preload.stages.length === 6 && preload.stages.every(s => s.ok === true)

controls.description: Both result payload files are bounded to under 64 KiB
Both ephemeral diagnostic containers are stopped, removed, and verified absent
controls.assertion: docker ps -a filter by id returns empty string for both containerA and containerB

controls.description: Main Postgres and Redis containers remain running, healthy, and untouched
Network fg-local_default retains identical ID and container membership
Ephemeral scratch directory in .runtime/t30 is completely unlinked
Runner reports status COMPLETE with zero error codes and nativeAcceptance false
